sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 2x Swipe Cards, 4x Keys, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Both body camera chargers reported missing.
Morning shift deployed. Due to wet weather, patrols focused on covered areas where possible.
Welfare check completed at Starbucks. All clear.
Arrived at the rear of 220 Queen Street to check the alleyway following a complaint from Data Centre management regarding an individual repeatedly defecating on the stairs.
POI located. Once he noticed guard presence, he began walking back towards Queen Street. Guards warned him that Police had been notified regarding his recent offending.
Arrived at Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Scoped. No issues found.
Arrived at Queen Street and Shortland Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks completed on ground level and Level 1. All clear.
Welfare check completed inside McDonald's Britomart. No issues found.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep and welfare checks on cafes and stores. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no issues present.
Arrived at Customs Street and Albert Street intersection. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. No issues.
Arrived at Federal Square and Cathedral Church. Walkaround completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe. All clear.
Response call from Sky Mart Convenience Store regarding a suspicious individual behaving abnormally inside the store.
Welfare checks completed at Little Albert's Cafe and Formery. All clear.

Arrived at Sky Mart Convenience Store. POI had already left and was walking around on the street. His behaviour appeared unwell and his balance seemed affected, possibly under the influence. Last seen walking up Victoria Street. Staff advised to call back if he continued causing disturbance.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced. Police present in the area, possibly conducting checks.
Patrol continued due to no activity occurring.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. No issues found.
Walkthrough completed along Elliott Street and Darby Street. No issues found.
Arrived at HQ for a quick restroom break while waiting for Team 2.
Debrief with Team 2 commenced. Teams split into two sectors.
Debrief completed. Both teams deployed and commenced patrols.
Patrol commenced down Queen Street, maintaining visible presence.
Response call from Jewellers Workshop, High Street, regarding three suspicious individuals in a red BMW parked in front of the store, reportedly wearing face masks.
Arrived at Jewellers Workshop. Group had a broken-down vehicle, which explained why they were parked in the area. No further issue.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding two street vagrants harassing customers for money and food inside the store.

Arrived at McDonald's Britomart. The two individuals were seated on a bench. Guards asked them to leave calmly; they complied. Guards advised they are not permitted to harass customers and that a verbal trespass may be issued if the behaviour continues.

Response call from Starbucks Queen Street regarding a female who was not a customer, used their restroom, and took toiletries from the cabinet. Assistance requested for removal. Team 2 notified and dispatched.
Walkthrough completed around Commercial Bay. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no activity requiring assistance.
Welfare check completed at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street and Albert Street intersection. No issues found. Patrol continued down Customs Street.
Welfare checks completed at Adidas, Movenpick, and Four Square. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at St Pierre's Sushi and Tuck Shop. All clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at The Coffee Club and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.

Arrived at bottom of Fort Street. Welfare checks completed at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Chargrill, Liquor Store, Thai Massage, and surrounding stores. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Sweep completed; stores and businesses checked. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along High Street and Vulcan Lane. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. All clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full walkthrough completed. All clear.
Response call from Ippondo, 229 Queen Street, regarding a group of street vagrants sitting in front of the store and obstructing business flow. Team 2 notified and dispatched.
Guards returned to HQ to exchange sectors with Team 2.
Arrived at HQ. Quick briefing completed. Welfare checks commenced along upper Queen Street. All clear.
Checked Mid City Shopping Centre and spoke with the static guard. All clear.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check completed inside Atrium on Elliott towards Crowne Plaza Hotel. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at City Convenience Store, Mr Barber, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear. Patrol continued through Elliott Street towards Bledisloe Alley. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. Welfare checks at Aotea Centre and Jack's Fried Chicken. All clear.
Response call from management requesting immediate assistance at HQ.
Arrived at HQ. Guards stood by for updates regarding a male sitting inside the office unannounced who appeared to be a street vagrant.
POI calmly removed from the office without escalation. A verbal trespass was issued. POI accepted the terms and was sent on his way.
Guards stood by outside HQ while awaiting further response calls.
Guards returned to the office and placed the Ops phone on charge due to low battery.
Lunch break while preparing for afternoon changeover.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment issued: 2x Vests, 1x Radio, 1x Body Camera.
Debrief completed with Team 1. Team 2 commenced patrols.
Welfare checks completed; store checks clear. Team proceeded up Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Full welfare sweep along upper Queen Street completed. No issues. Team arrived at Aotea Square and commenced sweep.

Response call from Starbucks regarding a female vagrant inside the store. The female is well known and trespassed from the premises. She returned, used the bathroom, and allegedly took two toiletry/tissue items and placed them inside her bag. After confrontation, the POI became agitated, verbally aggressive, and used racist slurs towards guards. The POI also knocked into a female customer while leaving the store.
Team 2 resumed welfare sweep up Queen Street.
Quick welfare sweep completed down Elliott Street. All clear. Patrol continued towards Victoria Street.
Welfare sweep up Victoria Street completed. No issues. Team returned towards Queen Street.
Vagrant outside Ava Chi was asked to move along. He complied with no further issue. Team proceeded to Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street. Welfare sweep commenced.
Welfare sweep along Lorne Street completed. No issues. Team proceeded towards Auckland Library.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Upper Queen Street welfare sweep completed. No issues. Team stood by for response calls while maintaining presence until route changeover.
Response call from Ippondo requesting assistance to relocate a vagrant loitering outside the store.
Arrived at Ippondo. Team spoke with the vagrant and respectfully asked them to relocate elsewhere.
Vagrant complied and moved along with no further issue. Team returned to HQ for route changeover.
Debrief with Team 1 and route changeover completed. Team commenced welfare sweep for stores on lower Queen Street.
Welfare checks along lower Queen Street completed. Team continued to Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and commenced welfare checks.
Welfare checks completed at Commercial Bay. No issues. Team stood by for response calls.

Response call from Mecca Queen Street regarding a welfare check on a member of the public who was concerning staff. The vagrant appeared unstable and was yelling at members of the public. Team proceeded to the location.
Welfare check completed on the vagrant. He was frustrated while looking for homeless shelters. Information and support provided. Patrol resumed towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep completed at Commercial Bay. No issues reported.
Quick walkthrough completed on Tyler Street and Commerce Street. No issues.
Welfare sweep completed on Gore Street. No issues reported.
Walkthrough completed on Fort Street. No issues.
High Street, Freyberg Square, and Chancery Square welfare sweeps completed. No issues. Team returned to Queen Street to maintain presence.
Presence maintained along lower Queen Street. Team returned to HQ for final route changeover.
Debrief and route changeover with Team 1 completed. Team commenced presence patrol along upper Queen Street.
Security presence along upper Queen Street completed. No issues. Team returned to HQ to charge personal phone and complete reports.
Team 2 shift completed. All equipment handed in and accounted for (2x Vests, 1x Radio, 1x Team 2 Ops Phone, 1x Body Camera). No further issues.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 2x Swipe Cards, 4x Keys, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras, 1x Charger.
Afternoon shift deployed. Guards stood by to recharge the Ops phone before continuing patrols.
Sector exchange completed with Team 2. Patrol commenced down Queen Street.

Response call from Ippondo Queen Street regarding the same individual from the previous day with an auto bike parked next to the store. Staff advised the individual works for Uber and would likely not remain long.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks completed. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no activity occurring.
Presence maintained within Fort Lane, High Street, and O'Connell Lane. All clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full walkthrough completed. No issues. Welfare checks commenced on stores in the area.
Patrol continued due to no activity occurring. Welfare checks continued along High Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street and High Street. All clear. Welfare checks commenced along nearby stores.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. Checked. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear. Guards returned to HQ urgently as Team 2 needed to submit Auror reports and complete their shift.
Arrived at HQ and prepared for end of Team 2 shift.
Response call from management requesting assistance.
Response call from management regarding a male in front of HQ causing a disturbance.
Arrived at response location. Area scoped for POI but he could not be located; he had possibly already moved along.
Report received regarding a female who placed multiple $3 items inside her bag at Daiso Japan and left without purchasing. Last seen heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Daiso Japan. Guards obtained a photo description of the female thief. Incident posted to Auror.
Full scope and patrol completed around upper Queen Street searching for the Daiso Japan POI.
Search unsuccessful. Guards patrolled back down Queen Street maintaining visible presence.
Arrived at HQ. Building checks commenced.
Response call from QF Tavern regarding an aggressive male refusing to leave and causing a disturbance inside the premises. Guards proceeded quickly to the location.

Arrived at QF Tavern. Guards removed the POI from staff and management and gave him the option to leave voluntarily or reasonable force would be used. POI complied. Verbal trespass issued. Bodycam footage captured and incident posted to Auror.
Response call from Starbucks regarding a street vagrant inside the store. Assistance requested to remove him.
Arrived at Starbucks. POI had already left the store.
HQ building check completed with no issues. Patrol continued with welfare checks along Queen Street.
Returned to HQ for quick break and to write Auror reports.
Welfare checks completed inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced. No issues found.
Patrol continued. Guards patrolled down Albert Street maintaining visible presence.
Welfare checks completed inside Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street and Albert Street intersection. Checked thoroughly. No issues found.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full walkthrough and welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Patrol continued and Charlie Route ended.
Arrived at Commerce Street and Customs Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street. Welfare checks at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Chargrill, and surrounding stores. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Welfare checks on stores and businesses. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Shortland Mini Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. Checked for vagrants. All clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full sweep and businesses checked. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along Lorne Street.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male inside the store harassing customers.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. POI had already left the premises.
Returned to HQ. Lunch break while preparing for night shift changeover.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:35 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Patrol commenced down Queen Street while conducting welfare checks.
Welfare check completed at Q Convenience Store on Queen Street. All clear.
Full sweep completed around Commercial Bay and Britomart Station. All clear.
Security presence maintained at Commercial Bay for nearby calls.
Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart and Japanese restaurant. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Karaoke Bar and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Wellesley Street and Mayoral Drive checked. All clear.
Full sweep completed around Aotea Square. All clear.
Security presence maintained at Aotea Square.
Returned to HQ. Floor checks commenced.
Welfare check completed at Chatime, top of Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Victoria Street and top of High Street. No issues.
Full sweep completed around Freyberg Square and Chancery Square. All clear.
Security presence maintained at Freyberg Square for nearby calls.
Patrol completed through O'Connell Street, bottom of High Street, Fort Street, and White Lady. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Gore Street and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear.
Welfare check completed at carpark next to Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Upper Queen Street checked. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Customs Street and Custom Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Fort Lane, Fort Street, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at High Street and High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Chancery Square, Freyberg area, and upper High Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Lorne Street and Auckland Library. All clear.
Darby Street and Elliott Street checked. All clear.
Patrol completed up Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrol completed along Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear.
Patrol completed down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear.
Patrol completed through Fort Lane, Fort Street, and bottom of High Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep completed around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear.
Guards returned to HQ for floor checks and 30-minute break.
Handover to morning shift completed. Night shift concluded.
